jobs.title: Founding Sales Development Representative (Southern Europe)
jobs.description:
Founding Sales Development Representative (Southern Europe)

Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We're a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

We’re looking for a Founding European SDR to help launch and scale Tremendous’ outbound motion internationally. As one of our first international SDR hires, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and booking meetings with high-potential prospects, while helping define how we sell into new European markets.

You will partner closely with Account Executives to generate meetings and act as the first point of contact for prospective customers. This role requires strong outbound execution across email, phone, social, events, and field marketing, with meaningful ownership over account development and early market strategy.

As a founding hire, you will have the opportunity to shape messaging, process, and best practices for international sales while directly impacting pipeline, revenue growth, and Tremendous’ expansion internationally.

What you'll do

  • Work primarily to bring in new deals through outbound prospecting for the Southern European Market

  • Own your pipeline through cold calling first. The phone is your primary weapon; you'll be expected to make 80+ cold calls per day, book meetings over the phone, and treat every unanswered call as the next opportunity to dial again. Email and LinkedIn support your outreach; they don't replace it

  • Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing, Strategy, and RevOps teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business

  • Use prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging

  • Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What you'll bring

  • You're fluent in English as well as Spanish and Italian to engage prospects across southern Europe.

  • You pick up the phone before you open email. Cold calling isn't something you tolerate - it's how you start your day, every day, without being told to.

  • Demonstrated history of consistently exceeding personal and professional goals, with a strong commitment to excellence in all endeavors

  • Curious, lifelong learner mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, staying updated on industry trends and best practices, and showing enthusiasm for applying newly acquired knowledge to improve job performance

  • Customer-obsessed sales approach, demonstrating a deep commitment to understanding and addressing the unique needs of our clients

  • Independent. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.

  • Collaborative. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.

  • Ambitious. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

What's cool about the role

  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: €39k - €45k. OTE: €56k - €62k.

  • Fully remote within Spain

  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Full-Time Spain

jobs.title: Helpdesk Technician Tier 1
jobs.description:
Helpdesk Technician Tier 1

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are seeking a reliable, tech-savvy, and customer-focused Tier 1 Help Desk Technician to join our IT team. This position is responsible for providing first-level support for end-user IT issues, including hardware, software, and basic networking problems.

You’re welcome to work remotely in Singapore.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Serve as the first point of contact for users seeking technical assistance in person, messaging, ticket, or email.
  • Log, categorize, and prioritize all incoming support requests in the IT ticketing system.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, resolve and document a broad scope of hardware, software, and peripheral issues (e.g., printers, monitors, network).
  • Assist with user account creation, password resets, and access permissions in Active Directory and other enterprise systems.
  • Install, configure, and maintain desktop/laptop computers, mobile devices, and software applications.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Tier 2/3 support in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and update asset inventory records.
  • Facilitate and support seamless onboarding and off-boarding processes, including workstation setup, re-imaging and return.
  • Follow standard procedures for proper escalation and ticket closure.
  • Provide excellent customer service by ensuring timely and clear communication with end users.
  • Extensively document actions taken and suggested resolutions in detail.
  • Actively contribute to IT knowledge base.
  • Assist with regular IT maintenance tasks, such as software updates and hardware checks (for both user endpoints and office infrastructure).
  • Ensure compliance with company IT policies and procedures.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Exhaust all possible scenarios within their access level when attempting to resolve an issue
  • Proactively seek feedback from peers, mentors, and leaders
  • Exhibits prideful ownership of work and proactively champions the needs of the team, users, and projects
  • Contribute to continuous service improvement by participating in projects and driving operational enhancements.
  • Build meaningful and fruitful relationships within the team and cross functionally
  • Fearlessly seek improvement personally, within processes, and within the team’s culture

We expect you to have:

  • An IT customer support background with 4+ years of service desk technical experience.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills in AV systems, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 (including Office 365), networking, software and MDM administration, along with experience managing enterprise applications such as Slack, Jira, Zoom, and similar tools.
  • Technical documentation and knowledge base (KB) writing skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or comparable service management systems.
  • A customer-first mindset, prioritizing employee satisfaction and support quality.
  • The ability to independently resolve technical issues across the support portfolio.
  • Strong organizational skills with the capacity to effectively prioritize and manage a busy workload.
  • A collaborative spirit, working seamlessly with cross-functional team members to meet employee needs and achieve company goals.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

Full-Time Singapore

jobs.description:
Sales Manager (Team Lead) – UK South

Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5, 000 specialists.

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems.

The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe.

Ajax Systems production includes four factories, two of which are located in Ukraine, one in Turkey and one in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead, mentor, and support the regional sales team in UK South to achieve individual and collective revenue targets.

  • Formulate and execute tailored market strategies and commercial plans for Ajax Systems products across the region.

Business Development & Account Management

  • Proactively identify and capture new business opportunities, securing meetings with key stakeholders and potential partners.

  • Strategize, prepare, and deliver compelling presentations to engage business partners, specifiers, and industry decision-makers.

  • Foster high-trust relationships with dealers, installers, and ARCs, ensuring clear communication of product features, benefits, and updates.

  • Advocate for the inclusion of Ajax Systems products in system specifications to influence purchasing decisions.

Partner Enablement & Market Presence

  • Actively represent Ajax Systems at trade shows, marketing events, and industry exhibitions to enhance brand visibility.

  • Gather market intelligence and customer feedback to guide management on product enhancements and future offerings.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Proven track record in B2B sales within the UK security sector (Intrusion, CCTV, Fire, or related security products).

  • Management Experience: experience with hiring, onboarding, leading, motivating, and directing a high-performing regional sales team.

  • Strong business acumen with an established network of contacts among UK distributors, installers, and integrators.

  • Understanding of UK security industry standards, distribution channels, and vertical sectors.

  • High technical competence with security products and the ability to conduct effective technical product demonstrations.

  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Proactive, self-driven, and results-oriented with a strong hunter mentality.

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 70–80% of the time across the region as required by business needs.

Compensation

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager Team Lead - UKI
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Manager Team Lead - UKI

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Enterprise Team Leader, Account Management (UKI Market)

We are looking for an experienced and motivated person to step into a Team Leader role within our Account Management team, focusing on the UKI market.

 

As a Team Leader, you will manage a team of Enterprise Account Managers, guiding them in enhancing client satisfaction within the UKI region. You will be accountable for your team’s KPIs, targets, and the establishment of best practices. We value a candidate with a strong strategic mindset and a passion for developing their team.

 

Are you an experienced manager with a proven track record in Account Management and a desire to further your leadership career? If so, we encourage you to apply!

 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and manage a team of Enterprise Account Managers, focusing on customer retention and growth within the UKI market.

  • Have a strong emphasis on People Management and Performance Development.

  • Be responsible for setting and achieving team KPIs.

  • Guide the team in strategic negotiations with key clients.

  • Enhance materials and deliverables tailored to Perk’s UKI customers.

  • Drive automation of Business-as-Usual (BAU) tasks.

  • Define team roles and responsibilities.

  • Oversee the onboarding of new clients in coordination with the implementation and sales teams.

  • Manage the onboarding and training of new Account Managers.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in a managerial role.

  • Previous experience in Account Management at Enterprise Level. Commercial experience is a plus.

  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent organizational and structuring abilities.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Strong commercial acumen.

  • Ability to analyze data and provide concise summaries.

  • Numerical literacy and ability to perform forecasts, with strong Excel proficiency.

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Important Information

  • This role is based in Birmingham or London and will require a 3 day week attendance

  • This is a permanent position.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager - 30mins Virtual

  • Assessment interview with two Mangers in the hiring team - 1hr onsite

  • Values interview - 30mins virtual

 

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Junior Logistics Executive (Netherlands)
jobs.description:
Junior Logistics Executive (Netherlands)

Important Information

This role is a full time, permanent, in office position.

Working hours: M-F, 10AM - 6:30PM

Location: Oude Meer, North Holland, 1438 BC

Contract: 6 month FTC

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the leading global B2B jewellery marketplace, Nivoda’s growth trajectory has skyrocketed over the past 12 months, and we continue to expand across new regions at an unprecedented pace. Our DNA centers on understanding our customers' needs and offering them a seamless experience. With a growing team based in major cities worldwide, including London, New York, Hong Kong, and Mumbai, Nivoda is becoming the go-to marketplace for the global jewelry industry.

We aim to be bold, innovative, and relentless in our pursuit of excellence as we transform an industry steeped in tradition.

The Role

As a Junior Logistics Executive, you'll be a key player in a tight-knit team. Working alongside highly experienced logistics professionals at one of our largest international hubs, you'll handle and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments with precision and care.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role that sits at the heart of our operations. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the smooth day-to-day flow of the office while upholding our high standards of accuracy and security. With our rapidly growing company, the opportunities for personal and professional growth are enormous.

If you're looking for a fast-paced, highly supportive environment where your attention to detail and reliability will truly shine—this is your moment.

What you'll do:

  • Shipment Handling & Repacking:

    Accurately handle, inspect, and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments in accordance with company protocols and international shipping standards.

  • Operational Support:

    Work closely with your two team members to manage the daily operations of the office, ensuring all logistics processes run smoothly and efficiently

  • Precision & Security:

    Maintain the highest level of precision, confidentiality, and security when dealing with high-value goods—attention to detail is non-negotiable in this role.

  • Team Collaboration:

    Collaborate with senior team members to align on priorities, share insights, and uphold our collective standards of excellence.

  • Process Improvement:

    Contribute ideas to improve workflows and increase operational efficiency as the company continues to scale rapidly.

  • Growth Mindset:

    Be proactive, reliable, and open to learning. This role offers strong internal growth potential for individuals who show initiative and dedication.

What you'll need for this entry-level role:

  • Strong Attention to Detail

  • Ability to repack/handle goods

  • Team-Oriented Mindset

  • Basic Administrative Skills

  • Trustworthiness & Discretion

Highly desirable

  • Experience working in high-security logistics environments, preferably with luxury goods, jewelry, or diamonds.

  • Familiarity with international shipping regulations and customs procedures.

  • Proficiency in basic logistics software or ERP systems (e.g. SAP, NetSuite, or similar).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Physically fit and able to handle small manual tasks as part of the shipment handling process.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented attitude with a willingness to grow within a fast-scaling organization.

What you'll get:

💸Competitive compensation

🍎Free lunch

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.
Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international coming from across the world. We kindly ask you to please submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

This is a full time position that's 100% on-site in Oude Meer. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

This ensures you're among the first to hear about openings aligned with your skills and interests.

jobs.title: Head of Agency, EMEA - Ad Solutions
jobs.description:
Head of Agency, EMEA - Ad Solutions

About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers, agencies and strategic partners to help businesses unlock value through AI-powered advertising solutions while maintaining strong standards for user trust, platform integrity and responsible innovation.

As OpenAI’s advertising business continues to scale globally, the Head of Agency, EMEA will play a critical role in developing strategic agency partnerships, accelerating advertiser adoption and shaping how agencies help their clients succeed with OpenAI. You will work closely with EMEA and global leadership to translate our advertising strategy into a clear plan for the region’s agency ecosystem.

About the Role

We are seeking an Head of Agency, EMEA - Ad Solutions to lead and scale OpenAI’s agency partnerships across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. You will own the regional agency strategy, building relationships with agency holding companies, their networks and leading independent agencies to drive sustainable revenue growth and advertiser success. This role is based in London and reports to the Head of Ads Solutions for EMEA.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will engage senior agency executives, develop joint business plans and commercial partnerships, and work with country sales and customer success teams to turn regional agreements into meaningful local execution. You will help agencies build the knowledge, capabilities and confidence to incorporate OpenAI’s advertising solutions into their clients’ marketing strategies.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations and Policy teams to ensure agency and advertiser feedback informs product development and go-to-market decisions. Working alongside global agency teams, you will align international partnerships with the needs of EMEA markets and help establish scalable ways of working across the region.

The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of the EMEA agency landscape with strong commercial judgement, executive influence and operational rigour. You are equally comfortable negotiating a strategic partnership, working with local teams to unlock client opportunities, and helping agency leaders understand the possibilities of AI-powered advertising.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and execute OpenAI’s EMEA agency strategy, prioritising partnerships, markets and growth opportunities across agency holding companies, networks and independent agencies.

  • Own agency partnership revenue goals and business performance, working with country leaders to establish clear targets, accountabilities and execution plans.

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with agency leaders across management, investment, trading, strategy, planning, activation, data and measurement.

  • Develop joint business plans that connect agency priorities with advertiser outcomes, with clear commitments, milestones and measures of success.

  • Lead the development and negotiation of regional trading agreements and strategic commercial partnerships, working closely with Finance, Legal and regional leadership.

  • Translate regional and global agency agreements into local activation, coordinating with country sales and customer success teams on account plans, advertiser onboarding and growth.

  • Expand the number of agency clients advertising with OpenAI and deepen adoption across relevant products and use cases.

  • Partner with Marketing and customer-facing teams to deliver agency education, leadership engagement and enablement programmes that build lasting capability across planning and buying teams.

  • Establish a disciplined operating cadence for pipeline management, forecasting, partnership reviews and tracking delivery against commercial commitments.

  • Define clear ways of working across agency, direct advertiser, country and global account teams to coordinate customer engagement and support shared growth.

  • Bring agency and advertiser insights to Product, Engineering and leadership teams, helping identify opportunities to improve the customer experience, measurement and product adoption.

  • Provide strategic direction and coaching to colleagues working on agency partnerships across EMEA, building shared playbooks and consistently high standards of execution.

  • Represent OpenAI’s advertising offering in senior agency discussions and industry forums, maintaining a strong commitment to user trust and responsible innovation.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 15+ years of experience in the advertising industry, including significant experience in agency partnerships, digital advertising sales or senior agency leadership.

  • Have a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets and building strategic agency partnerships across multiple EMEA markets.

  • Bring deep knowledge of the EMEA agency ecosystem and established senior relationships across agency holding companies, networks and independent agencies.

  • Have experience developing and negotiating complex trading agreements, joint business plans and multi-market commercial partnerships, and translating them into measurable results.

  • Understand how agency investment decisions are made and can build relationships across executive leadership, trading, planning, activation, data and measurement teams.

  • Combine strong strategic thinking with a bias towards execution, operational excellence and personal accountability.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d)

Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Job Overview

Our Structure team builds the software foundation for consistent, scalable index development at Solactive. We provide APIs, libraries, configuration patterns, testing frameworks, and reusable components for index construction workflows, supporting a great UX for ideation, production, and maintenance of new indices with clients. In this senior role, you will shape the technical architecture of a business-critical service that accelerates index development and improves quality across the index lifecycle. If you thrive on leading complex initiatives and shaping engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Tasks

  • Lead the technical direction and architectural evolution of the domain, delivering scalable and maintainable solutions for internal and external users of the index development service.
  • Lead complex initiatives end-to-end: clarify ambiguous requirements, shape solution approaches, and drive implementation across backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, including code and design reviews, coaching, and a strong focus on simplicity, quality, and maintainability.
  • Partner with product, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify core problems, challenge assumptions, and deliver solutions aligned with the platform vision.
  • Drive system design across distributed services, APIs, integrations, data models, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness.
  • Improve engineering effectiveness by refining processes, reducing friction, strengthening ownership, and enabling better trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk.
  • Mentor engineers and support their growth in technical depth, ownership, and end-to-end delivery.

Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on software engineering background (10+ years) with deep expertise in common programming languages. We use Java, Python, and Typescript.
  • Strong system design skills, including service decomposition, API design, integration patterns, data modeling, scalability, reliability, and operational concerns in cloud-native environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deploying, operating, and troubleshooting cloud-native applications in containerized environments.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous, business-heavy problem spaces: identify real requirements and root problems, structure chaos, and translate needs into quality technical solutions.
  • Proven track record of simplifying complex systems and delivering maintainable end-to-end solutions with high business impact.
  • Strong experience with modern engineering practices: code reviews, design reviews, CI/CD, testing strategy, observability, incident response, and production ownership.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Product mindset and delivery orientation: balances technical quality with business value and drives initiatives to completion.
  • Experience with React and TypeScript frontend development is a plus.

Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.
  • FinTech Excellence: Experience the cutting-edge world of FinTech at Solactive.
  • Modern Culture: Thrive in our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture.
  • Responsibility & Connections: Take responsibility from day one and build valuable relationships both inside and outside the company.
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 days of annual vacation, plus additional time off for Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve.
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package.
  • Community & Networking: Participate in our various networking events, tech talks, and business talks.
  • Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offerings.
  • Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, including a hybrid work model, all within a diverse and dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Director of Internal Audit
Workplace Experience - Healthcare Sites Development Manager
jobs.description:
Workplace Experience - Healthcare Sites Development Manager

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Healthcare Sites Development Manager

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

  • Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

  • Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally.

  • Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches.

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

  • Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time.

  • Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality.

💡 The Missions

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in Île-de-France, built to rethink occupational health with Alan's technology, for the benefit of employees and of healthcare professionals (HPs).

Its first medical centre opened at Valmy (Paris 10th) in April 2026, and 4 sites are already running.

Prévenir is about to scale fast: the ambition is to open several new small centres around Paris in 2027 (Seine-et-Marne, Val-d'Oise), first inside ready-to-operate sites, then in premises of its own (rented or bought), including a flagship centre in Paris. The exact plan is still being shaped, and you will help shape it.

We are looking for someone senior and visionary enough to carry the vision and strategy of Prévenir's sites from day one, while being happy (and excited) to be hands-on as much as needed, with a start-up mindset. Health, member experience and innovation are at the heart of the role.

You would join Alan as a full-time Alaner in the Workplace team: you work for Alan, not only for Prévenir. At first, most of your time goes to Prévenir: opening new sites, making them compliant and ready for patients with a real Prevenir's spirit, running the centres day to day with the center managers, and building the vendors, budgets and playbook that will let it grow from 4 to many more sites.

Prévenir is a separate entity from Alan: it signs its own leases and contracts, and you prepare, negotiate and advise on its behalf.

You will work alongside the Facility Manager in charge of Alan's offices at Valmy, and turn what you learn into playbooks, checklists and templates (openings, fit-out, vendors, compliance) that serve Prévenir's centres as much as Alan's own offices.

The position is based in Paris, with regular field visits across Île-de-France (Paris, Seine-et-Marne, Hauts-de-Seine, Val-d'Oise), and requires an onsite or field presence at least 4 days per week.

👀 More specificities on the profile we're looking for (level range targeted on our level grid: C1-D)

Detailed missions

Set the vision

  • Define and carry the vision and strategy for Prévenir's sites from day one: site model, technical and experience standards, and a 2–3 year real-estate roadmap, alongship Prévenir's and Alan's leadership and kept up to date as the plan evolves

  • Bring innovation: test new centre formats (shared, modular or temporary sites), and have a smart use of AI to make each opening faster, cheaper and better for HPs and patients

Open and build new sites

  • Find and technically qualify new sites: define search criteria with the Occupational Health team, visit candidate sites, and give a clear go / no-go recommendation with an estimated cost

  • Open small centres inside ready-to-operate sites: check that the host site works for medical use, agree the terms with the host operator (services, charges, service levels, who does what), do the light set-up and prepare the opening

  • Prepare and negotiate leases with Legal and Finance, and be the single operational point of contact for landlords, architects and vendors

  • When relevant, lead fit-out works end to end: brief and manage architects, project managers and contractors, plan backwards from the opening date, secure administrative and safety authorisations, manage acceptance and close snags

  • Contribute to the rent vs buy thinking by providing technical due diligence on any potential acquisition (condition of the building, works to expect, regulatory constraints, running costs)

Make every centre medical-ready, unique, safe and healthy

  • Make every site ready for patients: consultation rooms, patient flows, confidentiality (acoustics), hygiene and cleaning, medical waste, hand-washing points, IT / network and badge access set up with the IT team

  • Own the safety and security of every centre, for patients, HPs and visitors: access control, intrusion alarms and video surveillance where relevant (in line with GDPR), fire safety, evacuation procedures and drills, first-aid kits and defibrillators where required, and clear procedures for incidents and for HPs working alone

  • Put prevention at the heart of the run: identify the main risk areas of each centre (fire safety, HVAC and air quality, water, electrical, access control), build and run the preventive maintenance calendar, plan the mandatory periodic checks and keep each site's safety register up to date

Run the centres day to day

  • Run the day-to-day for existing and new centres with the center managers (ASSTs): sort and diagnose requests, fix what can be fixed, send the rest to the right contractor, and follow each intervention until it is done and checked

  • Own the logistical run of the centres in partnership with the center managers: supplies, snacks, mail, printing, small furniture and IT equipment, access and badges, cleaning. Agree a clear split of who does what and give them simple routines, checklists and documentation so they become autonomous

  • Create and keep alive the Prévenir spirit in every centre, as the Workplace team does for Alan its own offices: a welcoming, consistent and on-brand place for HPs, ASSTs and patients, using their feedback to keep improving it

Manage vendors, budgets and playbooks

Alan exists to end the wait.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare.

Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be.

We're working towards a more consistent engineering foundation across our applications. Think Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment and observability by default. We're bringing more senior engineering expertise in-house to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap our teams can own. And that's where you come in 😉

Your role

You will work across our engineering teams, helping shape the cloud infrastructure behind our digital healthcare applications. Your focus will be on making the right architectural decisions, modernising existing platforms and enabling teams to independently build, maintain and improve their systems.

This isn't a greenfield architecture exercise. You will be improving live healthcare platforms while balancing technical improvements with product delivery, security, regulatory requirements and the realities of working with stakeholders across different countries, including the Netherlands and Japan.

What you will be doing, among others:

  • Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps.

  • Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through.

  • Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies.

  • Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed.

  • Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership.

  • Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations.

  • Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: An annual maximum remuneration of approximately € 85.000 gross per year is estimated for this position (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii), depending on the interviews, your experience, background and knowledge.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. We do work from Mondays to Thursdays, as 32 hours per week is fulltime.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 5+ years of experience in cloud/backend engineering and multiple years of hands-on experience with AWS and Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).

  • You are comfortable reviewing designs and pull requests. Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures is very valuable. All combined with experience in serverless AWS, Node.js/TypeScript tech stacks.

  • You actively coach, pair, review and share knowledge, with a focus on building ownership and seniority across the teams around you.

  • You understand what matters: the importance of making pragmatic technical choices within clear security, compliance and regulatory boundaries.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

Partnerships Director, BCG EMEA

You will turn the global alliance strategy into a focused EMEA business plan and repeatable field execution that delivers customer and commercial impact.

About the Role

The Partner Director, BCG EMEA will lead OpenAI’s partner business with BCG across the region. You will own the EMEA joint business plan, build executive alignment, and activate BCG and OpenAI field teams to generate qualified pipeline, win strategic opportunities, and drive successful production adoption. You will align regional priorities and execution with the global BCG alliance strategy.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will connect senior executive engagement with joint account planning, co-selling, solution and delivery alignment, field enablement, governance, and day-to-day execution. Success requires a strong understanding of how a large, matrixed professional-services organisation operates, commercial discipline, technical fluency, and the ability to align teams without formal authority.

The ideal candidate has led a high-impact partnership with strategic partners, built measurable pipeline and customer outcomes across EMEA, and knows how to turn alliance strategy into account-level execution and successful deployments.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the EMEA partnership with BCG, including regional strategy, executive alignment, joint planning, pipeline growth, customer outcomes, delivery quality, and long-term expansion, in alignment with the global alliance.

  • Develop and execute an EMEA joint business plan with clear account and industry priorities, investments, decision rights, milestones, and measures of success.

  • Build trusted relationships with BCG’s EMEA leadership, industry and functional leaders, alliance teams, client account leaders, sales organizations, architects, and delivery leaders, while staying aligned with global stakeholders.

  • Translate executive priorities into repeatable field execution spanning account mapping, opportunity qualification, co-selling, solution development, technical engagement, delivery handoffs, and escalation.

  • Shape joint solutions and industry plays that combine OpenAI products and capabilities with BCG’s consulting, technology, data, security, governance, and delivery strengths.

  • Lead joint account planning and strategic customer pursuits with BCG and OpenAI field teams across EMEA, with particular focus on complex and regulated enterprises.

  • Create a clear engagement model for OpenAI sellers and technical teams, including when to involve BCG, how opportunities are qualified, who owns each step, and how channel conflict is resolved.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, Security, Legal, Finance, and Commercial teams to support complex customer engagements and remove technical, contractual, compliance, and operational blockers.

  • Build BCG’s EMEA field and delivery readiness through executive sponsorship, sales enablement, technical training, reusable solution patterns, and disciplined delivery handoffs.

  • Establish regional governance across executive business reviews, pipeline inspection, forecasting, milestone tracking, performance reporting, and escalation, connected to the global alliance operating model.

  • Set and monitor EMEA partnership KPIs, including qualified pipeline, conversion, production adoption, customer value, partner readiness, delivery quality, and return on OpenAI investment.

  • Prioritise OpenAI resources for EMEA opportunities with the greatest strategic value, commercial potential, customer impact, delivery readiness, and repeatability.

  • Represent OpenAI in senior partner, customer, and industry engagements with clarity, sound judgment, and strong executive presence.

  • Build the regional operating model and identify the team capacity needed to scale the BCG partnership across EMEA.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience leading strategic alliances, GSI, or advisory partnerships, ecosystem sales, business development, or enterprise go-to-market programs in AI, cloud, data, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

  • Direct experience working with BCG and deep familiarity with its EMEA organization, incentives, decision-making networks, commercial model, industry and functional practices, and enterprise delivery motions.

  • A proven record of leading a multi-year partnership or regional alliance business with measurable pipeline, revenue, adoption, deployment, or customer outcomes.

  • Experience designing and scaling joint operating models across large, matrixed organisations, including governance, account planning, incentives, staffing, delivery handoffs, and escalation.

  • Demonstrated success shaping and advancing complex C-suite enterprise transformation opportunities from strategy through production deployment.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to build credibility with senior BCG and customer leaders while remaining close to operating details.

Enterprise Account Executive

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
R&D Facility & Safety Specialist

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • On-site Technical Panel (3x60 min)

.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Internship - Finance (Dec/Jan start, 6 months)
jobs.description:
Internship - Finance (Dec/Jan start, 6 months)

Axelera AI is a fast-growing European AI hardware scale-up building high-performance, energy-efficient AI acceleration for the edge. We are looking for a hands-on Finance Intern to join our team for 5-6 months, starting December 2026 or early January 2027.

You will join at one of the busiest and most interesting moments of the financial year: the year-end close and the FY2026 external audit. You will work directly with our VP Finance and Finance Managers on real day-to-day finance operations, not side projects. You will learn how a high-growth tech company runs its accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations and audit, and get exposure to investor and board reporting.

Location: Eindhoven (hybrid, 2 office days per week minimum)

Start date: December 2026 or early January 2027

Duration: 5-6 months

Hours: Minimum 4 days per week; full-time preferred

What you'll do:

  • Accounts payable: process and match supplier invoices, help clear the AP backlog and handle supplier queries.

  • Accounts receivable: follow up on overdue customer payments and keep the receivables overview up to date.

  • Reconciliations: prepare bank reconciliations and support month-end close reconciliations.

  • Audit support: help prepare PBC (provided-by-client) lists, pull sample support and respond to auditor and external accountant requests during the FY2026 audit.

  • Investor and board reporting: help gather and organise financial information for investor updates, board packs and ad hoc finance projects.

  • Process improvement: help document key finance processes and support our work on automation in NetSuite and AI tools (e.g. AP invoice capture, AR reminders, bank reconciliation matching).

What we're looking for:

Must have

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's programme in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics or a related field, and able to do this internship with an internship agreement (stageovereenkomst) from your university.

  • Solid understanding of bookkeeping basics: debits and credits, accruals, AP/AR and reconciliations.

  • Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, basic formulas).

  • Interest in automation and using AI tools to improve finance processes.

  • Available for 6 months from December 2026 or early January 2027, for at least 4 days per week (full-time preferred).

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  • The right to work in the Netherlands. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  • Accurate, organised and comfortable working through a high volume of transactions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with an ERP system, ideally NetSuite.

  • Previous finance, audit or accounting experience (internship, part-time job or student role).

What we offer

  • Hands-on experience across the full finance cycle in a high-growth deep-tech company, including a live external audit.

  • Close mentoring from experienced finance professionals, with real responsibility from day one.

  • Exposure to NetSuite and to how finance teams are using AI and automation.

  • A monthly internship allowance.

  • An international, collaborative team and a chance to be considered for future roles.

At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager – Enterprise Hospitality (Lyon)
jobs.description:
Strategic Account Manager – Enterprise Hospitality (Lyon)

Lightspeed is looking for an experienced, strategically minded Strategic Account Manager to develop, engage, and closely support our most important enterprise customers in the hospitality segment over the long term. This role is remote-based in Lyon, France, with occasional travel to our Paris office.

In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for our largest hospitality customers in France. You will be responsible for driving growth, product adoption, and stakeholder management within your portfolio, with the goal of building true business partnerships. You will leverage data, customer feedback, and your SaaS expertise to create value at the enterprise level, while collaborating closely with teams across the business.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the main point of contact for our largest and most strategic hospitality customers

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive growth, retention, and product adoption

  • Proactively work on increasing product usage and ensure Net Revenue Retention (NRR) grows across your portfolio

  • Plan and lead quarterly business reviews and success plans

  • Analyze usage data, go-live milestones, and health scores to identify and mitigate risks early

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with C-level and operational stakeholders, positioning Lightspeed as a long-term strategic partner

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to deliver an excellent customer experience

  • Collect customer feedback and proactively share it with relevant teams to identify product gaps and optimize the overall customer journey


What you bring

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Account Management or Strategic Customer Success within a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with enterprise customers

  • A strong understanding of SaaS metrics (NRR, product adoption, expansion, renewals, churn) and the ability to use them to manage your portfolio

  • A strong sense of ownership; you are hands-on, data-driven, and highly skilled in relationship management

  • Experience managing complex, multi-level stakeholder structures and confidently engaging with C-level, operations, and technical teams

  • Fluent business-level French and English

  • Experience in the hospitality, POS, or hospitality tech industry is a plus, but not required


What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience…

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day

  • Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Exposure to modern and proven technology

  • Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.
