You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption.

You will work alongside engineering teams to build advanced AI coding workflows, integrations, automations, and evaluation systems—often using Codex itself as part of your development process. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery.

You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. Success is measured by production systems, sustained developer adoption, and meaningful improvements to how engineering organizations build software—not simply successful demonstrations or enablement activity.

This role is based in our Munich office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities for Codex and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered software development workflows that improve how engineering teams plan, write, test, review, debug, and deliver software.

  • Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, workflow automations, and production accelerators—often using Codex as part of your own development process.

  • Help customers progress from promising experiments to reliable production workflows, sustained developer adoption, and scaled impact across engineering organizations.

  • Design systematic approaches for evaluating AI coding systems using representative software engineering tasks, automated graders, production signals, and developer feedback.

  • Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, tools, developer environments, integrations, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and operational readiness.

  • Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive technical blockers toward resolution.

  • Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and hands-on enablement that help engineering teams understand and adopt advanced AI coding workflows effectively and safely.

  • Gather high-fidelity insights from real-world Codex deployments and translate them into clear product proposals, model feedback, and technical requirements for OpenAI Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

  • Create reusable architectures, tooling, examples, guides, and technical patterns—including contributions to resources such as the OpenAI Cookbook—that accelerate future Codex deployments.

  • Influence customer engineering strategy by helping technical leaders understand how AI coding systems can reshape their software development lifecycle, engineering practices, and organizational workflows.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering software or AI systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, developer tooling, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.

  • Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, integrations, or production engineering—not only program, enablement, or stakeholder management.

  • Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across modern software development environments; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

  • Are an active user of AI coding tools and have developed a strong point of view on how AI can improve developer productivity and software engineering workflows.

  • Enjoy building high-signal prototypes, integrations, automations, and production solutions that demonstrate and deliver what AI coding systems can enable.

  • Understand how to evaluate AI coding systems systematically, including designing representative tasks, automated evaluations, production signals, and mechanisms for incorporating developer feedback.

  • Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as developer tooling integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

  • Can connect technical decisions to developer workflows, adoption, engineering productivity, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, engineering leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

  • Are comfortable leading technical workshops and hands-on sessions that help engineering organizations adopt new development workflows and technologies.

  • Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous and rapidly evolving environments.

  • Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; deep prior experience with OpenAI products is not required.

  • Are able to speak English and German fluently.

jobs.title: Head of Region
Strategic Account Manager, SME - France
jobs.description:
Strategic Account Manager, SME - France

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Own growth across a portfolio of 50–100 SME customers, driving expansion, product adoption and strong Net Revenue Retention through a focused, data-led account strategy. You’ll identify the accounts with the greatest potential, build 12-month growth plans with CFOs and Treasury Leads, and create cross-sell opportunities across cards, spend, FX, billing and embedded finance.

  • Drive expansion and product adoption across an existing portfolio, achieving Net Revenue Retention and GMV growth targets.

  • Segment and tier 50–100 accounts to focus your time on the highest-impact retention and growth opportunities.

  • Build strategic account plans and 12-month growth roadmaps with CFOs, Treasury Leads and other key stakeholders.

  • Identify and deliver cross-sell opportunities across cards, spend, FX, billing and embedded finance.

  • Navigate complex KYB and compliance requirements, technical integrations and operational issues during onboarding.

  • Improve customers’ time to first transaction and support long-term product adoption.

  • Retain and grow customers in a competitive market by communicating the value of Airwallex’s broader solution, not just competing on price.

  • Partner with Product, Compliance, Support and other teams on product feedback loops, pricing changes, support enablement and a closed-loop Voice of the Customer process.

You’ll work from our Paris office three days a week.

What we're looking for


Essentials

  • 2–5 years’ experience in Account Management or Customer Success within fintech or payments.

  • A strong understanding of fund flows, acquiring and FX.

  • A proven track record of driving expansion and achieving Net Revenue Retention or GMV growth targets across an existing book of business.

  • Experience managing a portfolio of 50–100 accounts through rigorous segmentation and tiering.

  • Experience navigating complex KYB and compliance requirements, as well as technical or operational issues during onboarding.

  • The ability to map stakeholders, including CFOs and Treasury Leads, and build 12-month account growth roadmaps.

  • Experience retaining and growing customers in a competitive market by selling solution value, not just competing on price.

Preferred

  • Experience managing a senior-level portfolio of the top 50 accounts.

  • Experience contributing to cross-functional projects such as product feedback loops, pricing changes or support enablement.

  • Experience building a closed-loop Voice of the Customer process.

  • Multi-product cross-sell experience across cards, spend, FX, billing or embedded finance.

  • Experience working with multi-entity or international customers.

  • A second language beyond the primary market requirement.


You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

  • You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.


Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
jobs.description:
Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.#LI-DNP

Help people feel at home, beyond the booking.

Booking a place is only the beginning. Moving to a new country means navigating unfamiliar processes, managing payments, and building a relationship with a landlord—all while settling into a new life. At HousingAnywhere, we want people to feel supported throughout their stay, with the confidence that comes from knowing what happens next and where to turn when they need help.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Post Booking experience, with a strong focus on our mobile app. You will shape how tenants and landlords use HousingAnywhere throughout a tenancy: from preparing for move-in and managing payments to getting support and extending a stay.

You'll bring strong mobile app design experience and product thinking to make these everyday interactions feel simple, intuitive, and reliable—helping turn HousingAnywhere into a trusted companion throughout the rental journey.

  • Shape the long-term vision for the journey beyond the booking, making HousingAnywhere a trusted part of everyday renting.

  • Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration.

Project Manager - Facility Management

Over CBRE Global Workplace Solutions

CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) is wereldwijd marktleider in geïntegreerd facilitair management, technisch beheer, projectmanagement en vastgoedservices. Wij ondersteunen enkele van de meest toonaangevende organisaties ter wereld bij het creëren, onderhouden en optimaliseren van hun werkomgevingen.

Als onderdeel van CBRE, met meer dan 155.000 medewerkers wereldwijd, combineren wij lokale expertise met de kracht van een toonaangevend internationaal netwerk. Onze teams leveren innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van technisch onderhoud, facility management, energiebeheer, projecten en werkplekoptimalisatie.

Bij CBRE geloven we dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Daarom investeren we in ontwikkeling, samenwerking en een veilige, inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen kan groeien. CBRE wordt wereldwijd erkend als een van de meest bewonderde en ethische bedrijven in haar sector en staat bekend om haar focus op innovatie, duurzaamheid en talentontwikkeling.

Taken

WAT GA JE DOEN?
Ben jij een ervaren Project Manager met een technische achtergrond en een passie voor het succesvol realiseren van complexe projecten?

Voor ons Projects-team in Nederland zijn wij op zoek naar een Project Manager die verantwoordelijk is voor de succesvolle uitvoering en oplevering van uiteenlopende bouwkundige, technische en facilitaire projecten. Van complete kantoorinrichtingen en fit-outs tot kritische technische upgrades en de realisatie van serverruimtes: jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten veilig, op tijd, binnen budget én naar volle tevredenheid van de klant worden opgeleverd.

Je werkt nauw samen met klanten, leveranciers, onderaannemers en interne stakeholders en hebt de volledige verantwoordelijkheid voor projecten met een waarde van circa €25.000 tot €1 miljoen.

Als Project Manager ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het volledige projectproces, van initiatief en voorbereiding tot uitvoering en oplevering.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het leiden van bouwkundige, technische en facilitaire projecten van aanvraag tot oplevering

  • Het vertalen van klantwensen naar concrete projectdoelstellingen en programma's van eisen
  • Het aansturen en coördineren van interne teams, leveranciers en onderaannemers

  • Het zorgen voor volledige naleving van CBRE-processen, projectmanagementrichtlijnen en QHSE-standaarden
  • Het voorbereiden en presenteren van projectrapportages aan klanten en interne stakeholders

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag leid je een bouwvergadering op locatie, de volgende dag presenteer je een projectupdate aan een stuurgroep of bespreek je innovatieve oplossingen met een klant.

Vereisten

WAT BRENG JE MEE?

Wij zoeken een ervaren professional die techniek, organisatie en stakeholdermanagement succesvol weet te combineren.

  • Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Bouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Installatietechniek, Infratechniek of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Sterke organisatorische, commerciële en communicatieve vaardigheden
  • Ervaring met budgetbeheer, planning en contractmanagement

  • VCA-VOL of de bereidheid deze te behalen

Bij CBRE krijg je de kans om impactvolle projecten te realiseren binnen een internationale organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en ondernemerschap centraal staan.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer

Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

We are looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join our Data Team. This is a role for an engineer who cares deeply about product impact, user experience, and how systems connect to real business outcomes. You will work across the full stack, from the interfaces users interact with to the services and data layers that power them, and bridge the gap between our AI and data capabilities and the products people actually use. You won't just take tickets and ship code. You'll own features end-to-end: shaping the problem with Product and Design, building it, defining success metrics, and iterating based on real data. If you thrive in ambiguous, high-leverage environments, love shipping with judgment, and want your engineering work to be visibly tied to outcomes that matter, you'll fit right in.

Tech environment

This role is intentionally not defined by one framework or specialty. That said, you will likely operate across the full stack: a modern TypeScript web platform where several frontends and frameworks coexist, and where moving between them matters more than allegiance to one, that also ships inside our native apps through webviews and a native/web bridge; Python-based services and APIs; relational, NoSQL, and search datastores, data warehouses, and SQL; event-driven and distributed systems; cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines; and observability tooling. Depending on the project, you may also work with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, retrieval patterns, data orchestration, and product analytics and A/B experimentation.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and depth in at least one modern web framework. Our web platform is a large monorepo combining several frontends, where Angular and Astro/Svelte coexist. Comfort moving across frameworks matters more than allegiance to one.
  • Strong componentization skills: designing reusable components and shared modules whose logic lives in framework-agnostic packages, including web features that ship inside our native apps through webviews and JavaScript/native bridges. Our apps are Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and Swift/SwiftUI; you won't own them, but you'll integrate deeply with them.
  • Sound judgment on when to render server-side vs client-side (or hybrid), driven by functional and non-functional requirements such as SEO, performance, personalization, and caching, rather than framework defaults.
  • Experience working on internal platforms, operational tools, or product-heavy backend systems.
  • Experience with Python frameworks such as Django or FastAPI.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, and SQL-heavy applications.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures or messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar infrastructure patterns.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog or similar).
  • Exposure to AI-enabled product development: LLM integrations, agent frameworks (LangGraph/LangChain), LLM observability (Langfuse), RAG patterns, or workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. Product tracking at Fever runs through Dataverse, our in-house unified behavioural event layer built on server-side GTM, so knowing how GA and GTM work is enough to find your way around. We also use Mixpanel.
  • Familiarity with product experimentation: A/B testing, feature flags, and edge-side experimentation. We bucket anonymous users and run rollouts at the CDN edge (CloudFront Functions), with Statsig and Optimizely as the experimentation platforms.
  • Experience working on 0 to 1 initiatives or undefined problem spaces.
  • Demonstrated leadership through ownership of difficult projects with broad impact.

What success looks like

  • You turn ambiguous opportunities into working systems or products that create clear value.
  • You help teams make better trade-offs and avoid overengineering, fragmentation, and local optimization.
  • You improve not only what gets built, but also how decisions are made.
  • You become a trusted technical leader for important cross-functional initiatives.
  • You increase the leverage of other engineers and teams through your judgment, technical direction, and execution support.
  • You help connect engineering work to real operational and business outcomes.

Who will thrive in this role

You will likely thrive here if:

  • You are energized by ambitious, messy, high-leverage problems.
  • You like operating where priorities evolve and the path is not fully defined.
  • You care more about impact than about staying inside a narrowly defined engineering lane.
  • You enjoy combining engineering depth, product thinking, and business context.
  • You naturally look for the highest-leverage way to move a system, a team, or a product forward.
  • You want to play a meaningful role in shaping how the company builds and scales.

Why join Fever

  • You will work on some of the company's most strategic problems.
  • You will have real ownership and visible impact.
  • You will help shape products, systems, and capabilities that matter across the business.
  • You will work in an environment that values ambition, adaptability, pragmatism, and execution.
  • You will be surrounded by smart, driven people who care about building things that matter.

Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible schedule
  • Bonus
  • Stock options
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Health insurance from Day 1
  • English or Spanish Lessons
  • Wellhub Membership
  • Cobee (tax free allowance on restaurants and transport)
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce, you will tackle novel legal questions, bring clarity to complex regulatory frameworks, and partner closely with business leaders to build compliant, high-growth healthcare experiences across Europe.

  • Support German Operations: Serve as a key legal advisor on day-to-day matters across Germany advising on healthcare and pharmacy regulations, e-commerce compliance, digital health, and marketing.

  • First-Principles Problem Solving: Untangle complex, novel, or undefined regulatory challenges where traditional precedents don't exist. You will help build legal frameworks using first principles rather than off-the-shelf templates.

  • Commercial Risk & Disputes: Mitigate commercial risk, negotiate key partner/vendor agreements, and assist with advertising and competition matters (including Germany’s unfair competition / UWG litigation environment).

  • Drive Market Expansion & Growth: Partner with the international launch team to scale existing operations and launch Hims & Hers into new European markets, navigating local regulatory, legal, and operational landscapes from scratch.

  • Qualified Attorney: Admitted to practice in the UK, Germany, or Ireland (other EU jurisdictions considered by exception) with ~5+ years PQE in a top-tier law firm, tech company, or fast-growing digital health/telehealth business.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You thrive on novelty and ambiguity. When faced with a problem that has never been solved before, you dig into core principles to construct creative, compliant paths forward.

Inbound Sales 🇫🇷

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

jobs.description:
Solutions Engineer - Paris

About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

As a Solutions Engineer at Legora, you’ll act as a technical and strategic partner to our sales team, engineering team and prospective clients. You’ll help customers understand how Legora’s solutions solve their most complex technical challenges, lead technical discovery, create custom demonstrations, and support the end-to-end sales process.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a passion for working with customers to drive value. Your work will directly influence Legora’s growth and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical discovery discussions to understand customer pain points, use cases, and requirements.

  • Collaborate with our Legal Engineers to create demos and proof-of-concepts that clearly illustrate how Legora’s solutions address customer challenges and create value.

  • Facilitate technical workshops and proof-of-value sessions.

  • Respond to technical questions, security concerns, RFI/RFP responses, and implementation feasibility discussions.

  • Act as a trusted advisor and technical liaison throughout the sales cycle from early engagement to contract negotiation.

  • Design and propose scalable technical solutions based on customer needs and Legora’s product capabilities.

  • Translate complex requirements into clear architecture diagrams, implementation roadmaps, and proposal documentation.

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility, share customer feedback, and influence roadmap priorities.

  • Partner with Go-to-Market teams to shape deal strategy and shape technical strategy early in the sales process.

  • Support onboarding of technical sales content (demos and demo scripts, battlecards, case studies) that improve sales efficiency.

  • Work closely with Technical Delivery and Customer Success to ensure smooth transition from pre-sale to implementation.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).

  • 5+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or a customer-facing technical role (preferably B2B).

  • Experienced with having technical delivery discussions, responding technical questions coming from clients.

  • Experience delivering technical presentations and demos to both technical and business decision-makers.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

 

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - XTM One
jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer - XTM One

🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran.

💼 Your Responsibilities

Vision & architecture

  • Define and carry the technical vision of XTM One over the long term, with technical and product leadership.

  • Own the platform architecture: agent runtime and orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, data and context layers, APIs, permission model, shared commons.

  • Design for SaaS and on premises from day one: multitenancy, isolation, upgrade paths, configuration, operability in customer environments.

  • Arbitrate key decisions on scalability, resilience, security, maintainability and cost, including LLM latency and inference cost.

Standards & quality

  • Define the team's technical principles (architecture patterns, code quality, tooling, CI/CD, testing, development with AI assistants) and get them applied through docs, reviews, pairing and example.

  • Set the bar for observability and reliability of nondeterministic AI workloads: metrics, logs, traces, evaluations, and guardrails that make agent behavior measurable and debuggable in production.

  • Keep the right balance between features, technical debt and innovation.

Integration across products & XTM Foundation

  • Define how OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC and future products integrate with XTM One: contracts, authentication, data exchange, versioning.

  • Be a full member of the XTM Foundation: bring the XTM One perspective in, carry its decisions back, and keep coherence with the other Principal and Staff Engineers.

In the code

  • Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: VP of Technology

  • Key collaborators: XTM One engineering team and its verticals; XTM Foundation (Principal and Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC); Product leadership; open source contributors.

  • Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

  • Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python, the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI.

  • Strong system design: distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability.

  • A 360° view of software engineering: product need, design, code and tests, CI/CD, packaging and release, infrastructure and deployment, production operations, monitoring, incident response. A container image or an upgrade path is as familiar to you as an API contract.

  • Built and operated platforms delivered both as SaaS and on premises, including multitenancy and enterprise constraints.

  • Strong AI affinity. You've been building with LLMs by choice for a year or two, with LLM systems in production: agent frameworks, tool calling, MCP, RAG and vector search, evaluation, and the discipline to make them reliable.

  • Technical watch is part of the job. You keep up with your craft deliberately (reading, experimenting, prototyping) and turn what you learn into concrete proposals.

  • You define and carry technical standards: you raise the bar on a team, you don't just follow it.

  • Excellent written communication in English: design docs, ADRs and review comments that others learn from.

  • Autonomous and at ease in a remote, asynchronous culture; you drive problems to resolution and enable others instead of becoming a bottleneck.

  • Bonus: cybersecurity domain knowledge (CTI, CTEM, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII); extensible plugin or tool ecosystems; open source contributions or maintainership.

🛡️ About XTM One

XTM One is Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense. It is dedicated to creating and running cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatching their intelligence across the products of the XTM Suite.

Every product of the XTM Suite is connected to XTM One to leverage AI agents for a more proactive platform that is easier to use. Within XTM One, agents can use and correlate data across products to make the most meaningful assessments and take the most relevant actions. XTM One also hosts shared commons such as unified authentication and consolidated datasets and configuration.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

This opportunity is ideal for someone with a solid understanding of digital advertising who wants to move beyond campaign execution and take on a more strategic, publisher-facing role.

Publisher Relationship Management

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Help improve processes, workflows, and the overall publisher experience.


What We're Looking For



Must-Have Qualifications

  • Native-level Dutch proficiency, with professional working proficiency in English.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in programmatic advertising, AdTech, digital advertising, campaign management, or publisher operations.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in working directly with publishers and developing long-term business relationships.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Ad Manager or other advertising platforms.

  • Previous experience working with publishers, media owners, or advertising technology companies.
  • Experience in campaign optimization, yield management, or programmatic trading.

Previous Account Management experience is NOT required.

We encourage applications from professionals currently working in roles such as:

Marketing - First Hire (m/f/d), German Speaking

About The Company

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
  • Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
  • Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

jobs.title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Product Designer (m/f/x)

UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group.

We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy.
You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short.

What you will do:

  • Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them.

  • Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first.

  • Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path.

  • Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work.

  • Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one.

  • Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning.

  • Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them.

  • Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked.


Here is a good summary of what we are looking for:

  • Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team.

  • Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable.

  • Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it.

  • Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method.

  • Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction.

  • Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see.

  • Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability.

Bonus points if you bring:

  • Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products.

  • Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design.

  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design.

  • Experience with interactive prototyping.

  • Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity.

Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice:

  • Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective

  • Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year

  • Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment

  • Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few

  • Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year

  • Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership

Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English.

Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application.

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Run a customer project from kick-off to go-live, keeping budget, timeline and project hygiene on track.

  • Be the day-to-day contact for your customer, and tell them early when something is slipping.

  • Taken feedback and changed how you work, with an example.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.

Qualités recherchées

  • Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails.
  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.
  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire.

  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.

jobs.title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Model-Based Systems Engineer

About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

  • Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

  • Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

  • Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

  • Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

  • Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

  • Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

  • Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

  • Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

  • Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

  • Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

  • A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

  • Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

  • Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

Kenntnisse in der Regelungstechnik oder Erfahrung mit CAN-Bus-Kommunikation ergänzen Ihr Profil. Beides ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Mit rund 70 Mitarbeitenden in Krefeld entwickeln wir hydraulische und mechatronische Antriebssysteme für Kommunalfahrzeuge, Arbeitsmaschinen, Transportwesen und Freizeitbereich.

Als Teil der internationalen Eddie Group mit rund 3.800 Mitarbeitenden weltweit arbeiten wir mit Teams und Partnern über Ländergrenzen hinweg zusammen – bei kurzen Wegen und globalen Fertigungsmöglichkeiten.

Warum diese Position?

Kaum ein Projekt ist wie das andere: Unterschiedliche Branchen, Anwendungen und Technologien bringen neue Herausforderungen. Ihre Lösungen begleiten Sie bis zur Serie.

Im Zuge des Generationswechsels in unserer Projektierung übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Fachfunktion – mit Freiraum für eigene Lösungen und der Möglichkeit, Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung weiterzuentwickeln.
