Technical Support Engineer

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Technical Support helps customers and internal teams get the most from Airwallex’s products after integration. You’ll investigate complex technical issues, turn recurring problems into practical guidance, and help coordinate clear responses when incidents affect customers.

  • Support developers, merchants and internal teams with post-integration issues, providing technical guidance, consulting and best practices.

  • Investigate issues across code, software, hardware, devices and endpoints by designing and running test scenarios.

  • Configure test environments, payment APIs and ecommerce products to reproduce issues and support effective resolution.

  • Communicate technical issues clearly to customers and internal teams, identifying irregularities and unexpected behaviour in Airwallex products and services.

  • Create practical technical resources, including sample code, log-searching guidance and FAQs, for customers and internal teams.

  • Coordinate communication and responses between clients, internal stakeholders and senior leadership during global incident management.

  • Support occasional weekend and holiday on-call coverage as the business requires.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Professional experience in programming, technical support, implementation or a related role.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and appropriately with customers and internal teams.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel (Commercial Contracts and Regulatory)
jobs.description:
Legal Counsel (Commercial Contracts and Regulatory)

Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi's Legal team is small, senior and hands-on. We draft, negotiate and advise ourselves, and we bring in outside counsel only where local law or deal complexity demands it. This role sits inside that team, reporting to the Deputy GC, and owns the contracts that keep our payment infrastructure running: card acquiring, payment processing, banking and payout partners, and the technology and outsourcing agreements behind them.

You will work closely with Payments, Partnerships, Product, Compliance and Finance across our regulated entities in the UK, Ireland and Norway. The regulatory advice you give will shape the contracts you negotiate, and the contracts you negotiate will directly affect how fast LemFi can move with new partners and products.

What you'll build and own

  • Draft, review and negotiate payment processing, card acquiring, PSP, banking, safeguarding, payout and aggregator agreements, end to end.

  • Handle technology, SaaS and outsourcing contracts, including the ICT requirements under DORA and outsourcing rules for regulated firms.

  • Run the day-to-day contract flow through Jira and SpotDraft: NDAs, DPAs, amendments, renewals and terminations, turned around quickly.

  • Apply and develop the LemFi contracting playbook, templates and fallback positions so the business can move faster on repeat deal types.

  • Advise Payments and Partnerships on payments and e-money regulation across the UK, Ireland and Norway, covering PSRs 2017, EMRs 2011 and Irish and Norwegian equivalents.

  • Review customer T&Cs, product changes and marketing for regulatory compliance, and track incoming reforms such as the EU payments package.

  • Use AI-assisted contract review and drafting tools to handle a high volume of work without sacrificing accuracy, flagging where your own judgement overrides the output.

Your experience

  • Qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales or Ireland, or as an advokat in Norway, with 3 to 6 years' PQE.

  • Hands-on experience drafting and negotiating payment processing, acquiring, banking or payment partner agreements, at a law firm or in-house.

  • Working knowledge of payments and e-money regulation in the UK or EU, including the Payment Services Regulations 2017 or the Electronic Money Regulations 2011.

  • Experience with technology and outsourcing contracts in a regulated environment.

  • Comfortable managing a high volume of contracts, setting your own priorities and turning work around at pace.

  • Clear, commercial communicator: you write for non-lawyers without losing the legal precision that matters.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with card scheme rules (Visa, Mastercard) and their application to acquiring and issuing contracts.

  • Experience with DORA or equivalent ICT/operational resilience frameworks for regulated firms.

  • Fluency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, relevant for the Oslo base.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

Delivery Lead

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Project Management team

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead delivery across the projects in our Strategic pod, holding commercials to plan and surfacing risks early.

  • Spot where a project can grow, and bring cross-sell and upsell opportunities to the account team.

  • You see leadership as managing tasks rather than developing people and holding them to a high standard.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

hxer’s are at the centre of everything we build.   • Self-starter mentality. You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You know how to find and coordinate the right people across Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Customer Success, Partnerships and external partners.

  • Nice to have: Experience marketing to French enterprise or CAC 40 audiences, working with agencies or media partners, supporting paid campaigns, producing webinars or video content, and working with tools such as HubSpot, Google Workspace and Figma.

  • Location and travel: Based in Paris, comfortable working on-site and willing to travel occasionally for events in France.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct pipeline impact: Your work will directly support Sales and BDRs through events, content and ABM activations.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

Senior Legal Counsel (Corporate, M&A & Financing)

Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

Our Legal team is small, senior and hands-on. We do the work ourselves, cover each other's areas and use outside counsel only where local law or deal size genuinely requires it. You will be the group's lead lawyer on corporate structures, acquisitions and group corporate matters, working directly with the CLPO, the CFO and the founders.

This is a role for a corporate and finance lawyer who wants to run deals rather than manage them from a distance. You will draft, negotiate and close transactions yourself, bring rigour to how we manage the group structure across a growing number of markets, and use AI tooling to move faster and work smarter across every part of the brief.

What you'll build and own

  • Run acquisitions end to end - structuring, legal due diligence, sale and purchase agreements, disclosure, warranty and indemnity insurance, completion and post-completion integration - including targets that hold financial services licences.

  • Lead change-in-control approval processes with the FCA, the Central Bank of Ireland, the Bank of Canada, MTL regulators and others, coordinating closely with Compliance and the business.

  • Own the group corporate structure across the UK, Ireland, Norway, the US and other markets: capital injections, intra-group financing, debt-for-equity swaps and reorganisations.

  • Prepare board and shareholder resolutions, support board and committee meetings across group entities, and oversee entity management and company secretarial work.

  • Select, instruct and manage outside counsel on cross-border deals, agree fee estimates, challenge bills and keep deal costs within budget - pulling routine work in-house wherever it makes sense.

  • Support employee equity arrangements in close partnership with the People and Finance teams.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate first-draft work, due diligence review and research, so you can spend your time on the judgement calls that actually matter.

Your experience

  • Qualified solicitor in England and Wales or Ireland, or advokat in Norway (or equivalent), with at least 8 years' PQE.

  • Strong corporate, M&A and banking or finance experience, built at a leading law firm and ideally also in-house at a fintech, bank or regulated financial services business.

  • A track record of leading equity rounds, debt facilities and acquisitions from term sheet through to completion - you have been in the room, not behind it.

  • Experience with regulated entities and change-in-control processes across one or more of our key jurisdictions.

  • Comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and alongside founders, investors and lenders without needing hand-holding.

  • A hands-on, practical style: you write first drafts yourself, give clear commercial advice and do not hide behind caveats.

Nice to have

  • Experience with consumer credit funding structures such as warehouse facilities or forward-flow arrangements.

  • Familiarity with cap table tools such as Carta.

  • Fluency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

jobs.title: Delivery Engineer
jobs.description:
Delivery Engineer

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Delivery Engineering team

The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that) – we specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do.

The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. You’ll combine all of this with a growing knowledge of insurance technology to present 'the art of the possible' to our customers and help shape cutting-edge tech, while working alongside some of the brightest, most ambitious people in the tech and insurance industries.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own end-to-end model delivery on hx, from scoping and build through to testing, iteration, and customer delivery.

  • Build and maintain production-grade Python models, applying modern engineering and modelling practices.

  • Work directly with customer actuarial teams and internal stakeholders to solve complex, ambiguous modelling and coding problems.

  • Raise quality across the team through code review, testing, and contributions to best-practice model development guidance.

  • Support and mentor junior model developers through pairing, feedback, and day-to-day delivery support.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve our model development standards, tooling, and ways of working.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Shipped and maintained production-grade Python code in complex or data-heavy environments.

  • Applied predictive modelling or advanced analytics in real-world settings (insurance or reinsurance exposure is a bonus, not a requirement).

  • Taken ownership of ambiguous problems, creating structure and driving them through to high-quality outcomes.

  • Worked directly with non-technical stakeholders or customers, translating requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Operated effectively in a high-trust, high-accountability environment, proactively driving your own development and learning.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Additional perks

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Take-home Python challenge followed by Skills Interview - 1 hour

  • Manager Interview - 1 hour

  • Values Interview - 1 hour

  • Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Marketing Lead

About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Flock is on a hypergrowth trajectory, coming off a record-breaking Q3 and on track for Q4, and we're looking for someone to take the reins of marketing and drive the next stage of that growth. You'll do it at the frontier of AI in fleet insurance, in a heavily AI-powered business where AI is driving impact in every team.

You'll own Flock's marketing strategy, brand and budget, reporting to our co-founder and Chief Commercial Officer. We've dramatically increased the marketing budget because we're planning to go big, and you'll have a Marketing Manager reporting to you who owns events and content delivery. You'll set the direction, but this is still a hands-on role for someone who gets things done, with a run-until-tackled mindset and the drive to show how far a small, AI-native team can go.

Brand and launches. Flock has been through its acquisition by Admiral, and the Flock and Admiral Business propositions will become increasingly connected from here. You'll be central to taking that joined-up offer to market, owning how Flock by Admiral looks and sounds everywhere and leading every launch end to end. It's the best of both worlds, a fun, high-energy brand combined with the strongest name in UK insurance.

Growth. Every fleet we insure comes to us through an insurance broker, so brokers sit at the centre of how we grow. You'll build the campaigns, events strategy and broker programmes that grow both, alongside distribution, underwriting and product, and show what each pound returns.

AI. Our marketing is already heavily AI-powered, across design, web, email and video. You'll take it much further, building tools, agents and workflows so a team of two produces the output of ten, and you'll be the person Flock and Admiral turn to when they want to see what's possible next. Brokers and fleets still buy from people, so your craft and judgement stay at the centre of it.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Set the strategy. Turn company OKRs into a marketing plan, own the budget and report the return in pipeline and broker growth.

  • Lead the team. Manage and develop the Marketing Manager, and brief our agencies and suppliers.

  • Lead the brand. Act as the owner and protector of the Flock brand on every single touchpoint.

  • Launch and grow. Take products and propositions to market end to end, and run the broker campaigns, lifecycle emails and sales collateral that help our BDMs win business.

  • Shape the events strategy. Choose events where Flock should have presence and come up with bold and creative ideas, with the Marketing Manager running delivery.

  • Build with AI. Create tools and workflows, and share them so the whole business moves faster.

 

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years B2B marketing experience, including leading a function or major programme end to end, ideally in insurance, insurtech or fintech.

  • Product launches and campaigns with commercial results you can point to.

  • Strong brand instinct and craft, shown in your writing, your art direction and your eye for work that isn't good enough yet.

  • Experience owning a budget and showing senior stakeholders what it returned.

  • Experience managing people or agencies and raising the standard of their work.

  • An AI-native way of working, with tools, workflows or campaigns you've built with AI to show for it.

  • Ambition and ownership. You want to build something big, you move without waiting for a brief, and you can present to founders, Admiral leadership and a room of brokers with equal confidence.

Nice to have: insurance, fleet, telematics or broker distribution experience

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

jobs.description:

Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

We're hiring a Lead, Virtual Events & Launch Programs to build and run UpGuard's global digital event and launch programs: Summit, our quarterly product launch broadcast, plus a year round series and on-demand content engine that keeps security and risk leaders engaged between launches.

You’ll set the strategy for how we use virtual events to reach security and risk leaders, and run the program that delivers it: webinars, virtual roundtables, and digital event series for audiences in North America, EMEA, and APAC, including our quarterly launch event (Summit), where we showcase what’s new across the UpGuard platform. Your job is to make sure every event reaches the right people, gives attendees something worth their time, and creates pipeline for our revenue teams..

You’ll work closely with product marketing, demand generation, partner marketing, regional marketing leads, and our executive team, and you’ll be the go-to expert on virtual events across the business. Report results to marketing leadership and use them to improve formats and decide what we run next.

What will you bring?

  • 7+ years in B2B event or content marketing, including ownership of a global virtual event program and a recurring flagship virtual launch event at scale.

  • Experience setting event strategy and making investment decisions based on results.

  • Hands-on live production experience: building run-of-show, directing multi-speaker broadcasts, managing studio, AV, and streaming setups, and recovering a live event when something goes wrong.

  • Administrator-level experience running an enterprise virtual event platform (e.g. ON24, Goldcast, or BrightTALK) integrated with HubSpot or Salesforce, including data flows and attribution.

  • Experience managing event budgets, external vendors, and production agencies.

  • Excellent project management across many concurrent events and stakeholders in multiple regions.

  • Confidence working with executives, customers, and external speakers.

  • Flexibility to run some live events in North American and European time zones.

  • Experience in video editing and content repurposing.

What will give you an edge?

  • Experience marketing to security, IT, risk, or compliance audiences, or managing direct reports.

What's in it for you?

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

Europe or India, Remote
_______________________________________________

Hello👋I am Puneet, Co-founder and CPO at Kayzen, and I am now looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team 🙌

But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before?😃

Kayzen is the Apps DSP: an AI-native platform built on its own bidding engine, for buying app inventory across mobile and connected TV screens. App developers, agencies, media buyers and ad platforms use Kayzen to drive full-funnel outcomes across both screens, from awareness and consideration to installs, purchases and calls. Available through self-serve and managed services, Kayzen combines machine-learning optimisation with bid - and impression-level transparency, granular control over buying decisions, and AI capabilities that connect campaign data to the AI assistants teams already use. Kayzen’s vision is to democratise programmatic marketing by making it accessible to every team. Headquartered in Berlin, Kayzen operates globally.

The Team

You will work with a carefully selected, diverse, senior and globally distributed Data Science team (like Heiko, Chen) on various machine-learning models that process terabytes of data, serving billions of ad requests and users around the globe in real-time. We are highly motivated and aligned in our quest to disrupt the multi-billion dollar ad-tech industry. We would like you to be part of our journey, as our Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d).

Responsibilities

Our day-to-day work in Data Science and Machine Learning encompasses a wide range of activities, including:

  • Enhancing Models: Continuously improving existing models by incorporating new features, fine-tuning parameters, and utilizing additional data.
  • Algorithm Development: Collaborating with our Machine Learning Engineering team to develop and deploy scalable supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms.
  • Data Exploration: Identifying and exploring new data sources while researching innovative ways to leverage both new and existing data effectively.
  • Solution Research: Investigating new Machine Learning solutions to optimize every step of our value chain.
  • A/B Testing: Regularly conducting and evaluating A/B tests to drive insights and refine our strategies.

You’ll be a great fit if you resonate with the following principles of Data Science and Machine Learning:

  • Simplicity First: We prioritize finding the best solutions to challenges rather than forcing problems to fit predetermined solutions.
  • Impact-Driven: We leverage Machine Learning to enhance our product and drive performance for our clients, always focusing on tangible business outcomes.
  • Collaborative Spirit: Our teams consist of analysts, engineers, and data scientists, making strong communication skills essential for success.

Requirements

  • Strong coding skills with a focus on clean, reproducible, and well-tested code.
  • Proficient in key tools and technologies including Python, Spark, Hadoop, Airflow, Docker, and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with algorithms for handling sparse and large datasets, including applications in prediction, clustering, and outlier detection.
  • Experience in building neural network-based products for tasks such as classification, regression, and multi-task learning is highly valuable.
  • Bonus skills: Knowledge of reinforcement learning and large-scale optimization problems is a significant asset.
  • Good understanding of dashboards and SQL for developing and enhancing monitoring tools.

What do we offer?

  • Directly working with Founders and an opportunity to drive direct impact
  • Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity
  • A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market
  • A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Canada, Spain, the UK and many more countries.
  • A flexible work-from-home arrangement
  • Opportunity to relocate to our office in Berlin
  • A 500-dollar home-office setup budget

jobs.description:
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d) | Integration & Automation | Full-time

Help us build the future of public administration!

Ayunis is a Munich-based GovTech company trusted by more than 1000 cities, municipalities and districts across the DACH region.

With Ayunis Core, we are building an open-source AI platform that automates repetitive administrative work. We use cutting-edge AI and engineering tools to build cutting-edge agentic technology—both for our customers and for our own development workflows.

Tasks

Your role

As our first Forward Deployed Engineer, you implement customer projects on Ayunis Core: you connect it to the systems our customers work with every day and build the automations that run on top of them. Our go-to-market team scopes each project with the customer; you take it from there and deliver it in direct collaboration with the customer's specialist departments and IT.

You are a builder first, but not a ticket taker. Before you build, you check whether the problem is well defined and whether the planned solution actually solves it. Working closely with customers, you recognize further opportunities and feed them back.

Because you are the first in this role, you also build the foundation for a team: how we deliver, what we reuse and how the next Forward Deployed Engineers get productive quickly.

Your responsibilities

  • Implement defined customer projects end to end, from technical design to production, in direct collaboration with the customer.

  • Build connections between Ayunis Core and customer systems such as document management systems, council information systems, specialist applications and identity providers, typically as MCP servers around existing APIs.

  • Build customer-specific agents and automations on Ayunis Core.

  • Challenge project scopes before implementation: check that the problem is well defined, flag gaps early and propose better solutions where you see them.

  • Work with customers' IT departments, municipal data centres and software vendors to get access, permissions and security approvals in place.

  • Own what you deploy: reliability, monitoring and support for the integrations you build.

  • Set up the delivery practice: project templates, reusable connectors, documentation, estimation and handover to support.

  • Spot recurring patterns across projects and, together with Product and Engineering, turn them into marketplace integrations and platform features.

  • Help hire and onboard future Forward Deployed Engineers.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Senior experience as a software engineer building and operating production systems, ideally with TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Hands-on experience integrating external systems: REST and SOAP APIs, OAuth/OIDC, webhooks, file-based interfaces and synchronization.

  • Experience building with LLMs and agents, including tool calling, MCP, prompt design and evaluating results.

  • Comfort with Docker, Linux, networking and the security basics of connecting systems across organizational boundaries.

  • A track record of delivering projects for or with customers, including handling scope, timelines and expectations.

  • The judgement to question a requirement when it doesn't fit the problem, and the pragmatism to ship when it does.

  • Experience building up structure where there was none: processes, reusable tooling or a team.

  • Fluent German (C1 or higher!) and good English is required.

  • Experience with public-sector IT (e.g. DMS such as enaio or d.velop, XÖV standards, municipal data centres) is helpful but not required.

Our stack

TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, TanStack, PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible storage, Docker Compose, Hetzner, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry and multiple LLM providers.

No LangChain though – we've built our agent orchestration from the ground up.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A competitive salary

  • €2,000 annual personal development budget

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Significant influence over an open-source product and engineering organization

  • Flexible working hours, hybrid work and EU workations

  • Modern Munich office and equipment

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Public transport subsidy and Wellpass

Interested? We look forward to hearing from you.

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Your Mission with us

Do you want to learn how to run successful campaigns with some of Europe's most exciting influencers and build lasting partnerships?

We are looking for an intern for at least six months in Influencer & Content Creator Marketing. You will support our creator marketing team in bringing our vision of a healthier life through innovative probiotics to more people. Working alongside a dynamic and motivated team, you will help grow our brand Kijimea in the Italian and Spanish market through authentic influencer collaborations across all different creator levels and creative social media campaigns.

 

Your Tasks

  • You support the identification and outreach of suitable influencers and content creators, with a focus on the Italian and Spanish market.

  • You stay in close contact with influencers and content creators, coordinate their content, and maintain long-term relationships.

  • You contribute creative campaign ideas, help implement them with the team, and analyze performance (reach, engagement, ROI).

  • You follow current social media trends and bring your own ideas into future projects.

 

Your Profile

  • You are studying business administration, economics, marketing, or a comparable field (e.g., life sciences or communication science) with excellent academic performance.

  • You can support our team as an intern for at least six months onsite in our office in Gräfelfing (near Munich).

  • You have an affinity for social media and enthusiasm for influencer marketing. Ideally, you already have initial experience in marketing or with influencers/creators - knowledge of the Italian and Spanish market (media and brand landscape, influencers, consumer behavior) is a strong advantage.

  • You work in a structured, data-driven way and with great attention to detail

  • You communicate confidently with external partners and thrive in a fast-paced and analytical environment

  • You speak Italian and English fluently (C1 or higher) and Spanish at conversational (B1-B2) level. German and other European languages is an advantage

 

Our Promise

We offer you a varied, demanding job with exciting tasks and wide scope for shaping your role! With us, you will find short decision-making paths, responsibility from day one, and the freedom to try new approaches. You will join a highly motivated team and a real sense of purpose: with your personal contribution, help give millions of people a new lease on life.

We see the world through the lens of our psyche — like looking through a window that casts the outside world in shades of gray or vibrant colors. When people gain access to this insight, mental barriers transform into opportunities for personal growth, leading to a more fulfilling and happy life. And because happiness is contagious, society changes—one mind at a time.

You studied psychology. Now what?

You love psychology. You've spent years learning how people think, feel and change. But you don't see yourself in a therapy room every day, and the other doors everyone points you to don't feel quite right either.

There is another one. At Aepsy, you'll work with psychologists instead of patients: finding them, supporting them, growing a community together and helping them build a practice they love. Your psychology background isn't a nice-to-have here. It's the reason psychologists will trust you.

The role

As Community Manager Romandie, you own our community of French-speaking psychologists in Switzerland, as part of our Community & Operations team in Zurich alongside the leads for our German-, Italian- and English-speaking communities. You find and onboard psychologists, you are their first point of contact, help them with administrative and everyday questions, and look out for new opportunities so they can bloom. Together, we will shape the role around your strengths and passions. This is a starting position designed to grow fast, with real ownership from your first weeks.

Be their voice inside Aepsy

  • Bring psychologists' feedback into our product, processes and operations

  • Work closely with our marketing, product & design, sales and insurance partnerships teams

Key things we are looking for

  • You enjoy reaching out to people, finding out authentically what the right path is for them. When something gets in their way, you don't just take it away, you want to make it better. This role needs both: the courage to reach out and the heart to take care.

  • You're structured and at the same time full of ideas you want to push for. You're proactive, see opportunities in challenges, and thrive in a team where everyone supports each other and grows for something bigger.

  • If you hear about Aepsy's mission, your heart should beat faster, and your hand should instinctively reach out — because you won't want to miss the opportunity to be part of it. We need people who are crazy enough to believe that their actions can change the world.

In a nutshell

Together with us

We are a vibrant team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs, and we genuinely love what we do. We love conversations about the big picture as much as the smallest details. We work hard to make the world a slightly better place.

At the same time, we are mothers, fathers, husbands and wives, wine lovers, stand-up comedians, musicians, dancers, yoga practitioners, and Zen monks who appreciate and enjoy life.

Ready to join?

Sleep on it, take another look at this job ad. Read it again, believe that you belong at Aepsy, take a deep breath, and send us a personal application letter. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
jobs.description:
Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)

About the role

Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it.

What You'll Do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for finance: specify the tables, fields, and business rules — entities, currencies, financial dimensions, intercompany — and validate the result against the ledger before anyone relies on it.
  • Prepare and quality-check entity-level data extractions from our lakehouse and ERP in support of the external audit, and keep audit requests tracked from request to delivery.
  • Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review.
  • Describe our finance data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves.
  • Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month.
  • Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field.
  • A genuine finance background is essential — experience in external or internal audit, controlling, financial reporting, or FP&A. This is not a data role with finance on the side; you need to understand the accounting behind the figures.
  • Confident with general ledger and subledger structures, trial balances, accounts payable and accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and the principles of IFRS.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
  • Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
  • Able to explain data to finance colleagues and accounting logic to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is a strong advantage — the general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable modules, and the data structures underneath them. We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click.
  • A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it.
  • Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage.

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one.

You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through.

Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.

jobs.title: Quantum Processor Development Lead
jobs.description:
Quantum Processor Development Lead

About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Quantum Processor Development Lead you own people management and project leadership for our quantum processor developement. You rapidly grow the team by recruiting key members, while maintaining a high level of care and support for the team members. You report to the VP of Product and work closely with them to shape the team that defines the direction of key technical development at QuantWare. You will work with some of the smartest and most passionate people in the field, helping us build the world's most powerful quantum processors, as fast as possible.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own and drive processor development

    • Manage development work - particularly chip design and cryogenic measurement.

    • Run smaller, self-contained projects within your team - supporting both department and company-wide initiatives.

    • Partner with assigned Program Managers on larger, cross-department programs, particularly regarding technical execution and requirements compliance of QPUs.

  • Manage uncertainty and technical risk

    • Identify technical risks and bottlenecks early

    • Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies

    • Adapt experimental strategies dynamically based on new information

  • Develop engineering practices within the team

    • Develop a deep technical understanding of quantum processor technology to guide sound, well-informed decisions.

    • Implement strong and lean technical processes that support sound decision making processes. For example: requirements flowdown, trade studies, root cause corrective action methods, etc.

  • Support growth and development of the team

    • Contribute to defining role profiles and act as hiring manager for new roles across the programme.

    • Mentor engineers and project leads in programme execution and collaborative leadership.

    • Manage the engineers in your technology area: hire, coach, review performance, and grow careers.

Your Profile

  • Technical background

    • MSc, PhD, or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, microwave/RF engineering, semiconductor technology, or a related field.

    • Understanding of the development lifecycle for chip-level technologies; experience with superconducting qubits or cryogenic systems is a strong plus.

  • Leadership experience

    • 4+ years delivering complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a project management capacity.

    • Show people-management experience: hiring, coaching, and performance management.

    • Lead projects as part of a larger program, with control over one’s own domain.

    • Run smaller projects directly, without needing dedicated program-management support.

    • Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts.

    • Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus.

  • Approach

    • Translate a long-term technical strategy into an execution plan for your team.

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty.

    • Draw a clear line between technical leadership and program management, and partner with Program Managers instead of duplicating their function.

  • Communication

    • Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating technical ideas.

    • Communicate fluently in English.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

jobs.title: Projectleider Gebiedsontwikkeling
jobs.description:
Projectleider Gebiedsontwikkeling

Als projectleider gebiedsontwikkeling bij Waalpartners speel je een cruciale rol in het realiseren van de nieuwbouwopgaven van onze opdrachtgevers. Jij bewaart het overzicht, staat naast de opdrachtgever en draagt bij aan oplossingen voor de uitdagingen die woningbouw met zich meebrengt. Zo hebben we recentelijk meegedacht voor de nieuwe woonomgeving ‘Vlijweide’ in Dordrecht. Bij deze locatie ontwikkeling komt nogal wat bij elkaar. Water, bodem, ecologie, een primaire waterkering én verschillende partijen met ieder hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid en expertise. En dat alles om een toekomstbestendig nieuw woongebied te ontwikkelen.

Dit ga je doen

Met je brede kennis en jarenlange ervaring sta je stevig in een dynamische projectomgeving. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie.

Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt.

Dit ben jij

Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen. Je omgeving ziet je als collegiaal en je neemt verantwoordelijkheid over je project en de ontwikkeling van de projectteamleden.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 – €6.900 bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

  • Groeipad. Met onze Waalacademy bouw je stevig aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • Flexibele werktijden. Kom je liever om half 8 binnen, in plaats van half 9? Geen probleem.

  • Hybride werken. We zien je graag op kantoor, omdat we veel met elkaar en onze opdrachtgevers overleggen en samenwerken. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om thuis te werken, daarom mag je 2 dagen per week vanuit huis werken (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband).

  • 27 vakantiedagen

  • Resultaatafhankelijke winstdeling. Draaien we samen een goed jaar? Dan profiteer jij daar ook van!

  • Een goede pensioenregeling onder het oude pensioenstelsel.

  • Een elektrische auto van de zaak, die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Plezier. We werken niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van onze omgeving en onszelf, maar hebben ‘t ook leuk met elkaar. Onze personeelsvereniging organiseert regelmatig activiteiten, we gaan samen op citytrip of een paar kilometer hardlopen.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Je hebt de drive om een project voor alle belanghebbenden tot een goed einde te brengen.

  • Jij vindt het belangrijk om jezelf, samen met je collega’s, te blijven ontwikkelen.

  • Je hebt een civieltechnische opleiding (hbo werk- en denkniveau).

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt jezelf goed verwoorden: In gesprek en op papier.

  • Je hebt de ervaring om complexe projecten te doorzien en te begeleiden.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor thema’s als binnenstedelijke herinrichting, klimaatadaptatie of geotechniek.

jobs.title: Territory Manager (Manawatu-Whanganui)
jobs.description:
Territory Manager (Manawatu-Whanganui)

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

Farmers with Halter are writing the playbook for a world-first farming system, they are paving a new way of managing their land and animals, and in doing so, are unlocking more productive and sustainable uses of the world's agricultural land along with driving optimal profitability outcomes.

We've more recently launched into the Beef Market! This is an opportunity to build a new market from the bottom up. The Beef industry has not had a disruptive and influential product in years and this is your chance to make a huge impact.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is based in the Manawatu-Whanganui region. Applicants must live within the region. Travel is required to meet with farmers daily.


Who are we looking for

  • Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

  • Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You will be a high-performing value-based salesperson, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

  • Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

  • Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

  • Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What your day could look like

  • Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

  • Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

  • Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

  • Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

  • Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

  • Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

  • Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Our Benefits

  • Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

  • We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Full-Time New Zealand

jobs.title: Capital Markets Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Capital Markets Manager (m/f/d)

𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Many management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds, yet they struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren’t built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so our clients can launch and run ETFs at scale, helping broaden the access to the market beyond a small group of dominant, US-based providers.

𝘕𝘢𝘳𝘰𝘐𝘘 𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘎𝘋𝘗 𝘰𝘧 𝘌𝘶𝘳𝘰𝘱𝘦.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗜𝘁 𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹

You sit at the operational 𝘤𝘰𝘳𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮. You will own end-to-end responsibility for the ETFs we run: smooth product launches, day-to-day execution and oversight, as well as continuous platform evolution in collaboration with our product team. This is a strongly hands-on role combining investment expertise, market microstructure understanding, operational excellence and cross-functional execution.

You will gain 𝘥𝘦𝘦𝘱 𝘦𝘹𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘧𝘶𝘭𝘭 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘷𝘢𝘭𝘶𝘦 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘪𝘯, from investment implementation and market mechanics to operational and technology execution. You will have the opportunity to gradually expand your scope into platform building, process scaling, new strategic projects and service development.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂’𝗹𝗹 𝗗𝗼

Capital Markets

  • Own end-to-end ETF delivery across capital markets, portfolio replication and platform operations

  • Implement and continuously improve replication models; execute index rebalances and support advisory mandates

  • Own ETF quality monitoring (tracking error/difference, liquidity/spreads, premiums/discounts, order books), run root-cause analyses and implement corrective actions

  • Manage creation/redemptions and associated cash flows; oversee daily ETF operations from a portfolio perspective

  • Support larger secondary market transactions, produce/interpret trade reporting and support ETF launches

Portfolio Management

  • Take investment ownership for assigned ETFs, actively optimizing portfolio construction, risk and execution to enhance tracking and liquidity

  • Execute portfolio replication and rebalancing

  • Run daily validation and reconciliation of key data outputs (pricing, holdings and reference data)

Clients and Ecosystem

  • Join client demos and workshops as our capital markets expert

  • Represent NaroIQ at industry events, roundtables and conferences together with our Growth team

  • Support our Growth and Clients teams on client-specific questions

Working with Product

  • Raise requirements from daily operations and give business sign-off on what Product delivers

  • Use and stress-test the AI-driven workflows we build for ETF operations, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗟𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗙𝗼𝗿

(𝘠𝘰𝘶 𝘥𝘰𝘯’𝘵 𝘯𝘦𝘦𝘥 𝘵𝘰 𝘬𝘯𝘰𝘸 𝘪𝘵 𝘢𝘭𝘭 – 𝘣𝘶𝘵 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘴𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘭𝘥 𝘣𝘦 𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘥𝘺 𝘵𝘰 𝘥𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘪𝘯, 𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘧𝘢𝘴𝘵 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘵𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘪𝘯𝘪𝘵𝘪𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘷𝘦)

  • Experience in ETF operations, capital markets, trading, portfolio management, or fund operations

  • Strong understanding of ETF primary/secondary market mechanics

  • Hands-on experience running a portfolio management system, ideally to the point of owning its setup, data and daily use

  • Comfort with operational excellence: high ownership, detail orientation and reliability in a mission-critical operating environment

  • Experience working at the intersection of finance and tech

  • Analytical strength and ability to translate domain needs into clear product requirements

  • You use AI tools in your daily work and would rather automate a process than run it by hand

  • Comfortable being the external face of the function: with market makers, at industry events and in client demos

  • Fluent in English and German

  • CAIA/CFA is a plus

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗡𝗮𝗿𝗼𝗜𝗤

We’re building something ambitious – and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that’s 𝘭𝘰𝘸-𝘦𝘨𝘰, 𝘩𝘪𝘨𝘩-𝘪𝘮𝘱𝘢𝘤𝘵 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘨𝘦𝘯𝘶𝘪𝘯𝘦𝘭𝘺 𝘦𝘹𝘤𝘪𝘵𝘦𝘥 about what they’re doing.

Here’s what we care about:

🔑 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵 𝗢𝘄𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom – and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🧘‍♂️ 𝗙𝗹𝗲𝘅𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 Exceptional work doesn’t require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We’re remote-friendly and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀 𝗪𝗲 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗛𝗼𝘂𝘀𝗲 We don’t believe in constant travel, but we do make time for real-life moments – like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions – to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ 𝗛𝗶𝗿𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝗽𝗶𝗸𝗲𝘀 We don’t expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We’re building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

💡 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 – 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗙𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗼𝘄𝘀 𝗧𝗵𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵 Customers are basically the only reason we exist. And we don’t build tech for tech’s sake. But the best user experiences usually rely on thoughtful, powerful engineering – so we invest in both, deeply.

🛠 𝗗𝗲𝗳𝗮𝘂𝗹𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗥𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗸 We don’t accept “that’s just how it is.” We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there’s a better way.

💅🏼 𝗚𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗲𝗹𝗳 𝗮 𝗟𝗶𝘁𝘁𝗹𝗲 𝗧𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁 We use hrmony, so you can spend up to €50/month on the little things that bring you joy – Urban Sports, DAZN, Mediamarkt, Thalia, whatever suits you.

🤓 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗖𝘂𝗿𝘃𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 Everyone at NaroIQ gets €1,000 per year for courses, books, coaching, or whatever helps them grow.
